chapter: Family, education and the gap years
title: Teaching, further education and her children's degrees
summary: She did little teaching because she was furthering her education and rearing children. She never finished her degree but hopes to; both children have degrees.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: You mentioned teaching your children… Well, I did.
I didn't do too much teaching over here because I just didn't have time. I was furthering my education and then I was rearing my children.

Did you take up regular… As I said, I don't want to try to get personal, I want to ask you all these questions so you don't have to ask… But did you go back to school, like to college or something? Or did you… Music, did you mean?
I furthered my education literarily as well as musically.
Yes, that's what I thought you meant that. I wasn't sure. And… It's nice to do that because a lot of people when they raise a family, they never think of…
Of course, I never did get my degree.
I just didn't get it. But I still hope to. I don't feel that I'm too old. That's…
I know a lot of people keep on… Sometimes you read about some grandmother even that will get her college degree somewhere.

Because after my children started getting up some size, then I had to think about their education. Yes, that's right. And both of them have college degrees. So… Of which I'm very proud. But now that they are grown, well, I think about going back.
That would be nice if you have time. And the music doesn't keep people so busy nowadays like in the old days. It looks like it's not quite what it used to be.
And then I had so much on my hands with trying to rear a family. Yes. But… I've had quite a full life, of which I have enjoyed.
